title: Minigame: D3.7 Vehicle Breakdown

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the D3.7 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): a board where a vehicle fires, its weapon's numbers entered by hand.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): a vehicle weapon's breakdown is asked of its numbers and an Original DR on the Rule Workbench.

introduction: What an Original DR does to a vehicle's weapon: D3.71's IS-3 example, a plain malfunction, and an MG's 12.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
